en.avg3_1308: Sentinel of Dawn Soldier F A

steps: Ten days earlier. While the Philae disguise proceeds smoothly, Nazuka and Firenze secretly gather allies just in case. After a round of quick arrangements, the Petal Bloom Guild meets you without issue.
08:20, Nebula Month 8th, Greenhouse District, Lab Core
Th-That's all for today! Keep safe out there!
Phew. Okay, ==SEX=='s gone.==W== ==SEX1== won't reach out for a while, so we're clear to talk about "the plan."
My, my.==W== Everything is going perfectly, so why that tragic look on someone's face?
What? There's no tragic look! Yes, I miss hearing ==SEX3== voice every single day. But this is a necessary sacrifice! It means we get to stay together later!
Heh,==W== I was talking about Chitose.==W== But someone is a little eager to confess.
My ==SEX11==... The wisteria still blooms just as it did on the day we reunited. Yet, the rain has washed away the last traces of your presence.
I will survive the coming days by clinging to our shared memories. My longing will sustain me until we meet again.
See, Nazuka? Take notes.==W== Keep burying your feelings, and others are gonna swoop in. You'll be left completely in the dust.
Why does it end up like this...==W== I was the one who made a promise with ==SEX4== first... I was the first...!
Nazuna! Wearing Boss's face does not give you a free pass to spout nonsense!
Waaah!==W== Nazuka is angry! Hide me!
Please temper your anger, Lady Nazuka. There is no need to take Nazuna's teasing to heart.
You have never been dishonest about your feelings. I am certain my ==SEX11== understands your heart just by looking at you.
S-See? Exactly! Boss knows how I feel without me having to say it! See, Nazuna? Chitose gets it.
Um, Lady Nazuka, would you like a cold towel? Your face is glowing like a blade fresh from the forge.
Yep. A face like that really does say a thousand words.
Ahem. Let us settle down. I appreciate the high spirits, but we are on a tight schedule. Back to business.
Nyx, status on the anti-eavesdropping circle?
Airtight. Not even a fly is getting in. Whatever we say in this room stays in here.
Good. Now, the bad news. Our little decoy stunt didn't attract much attention. The Salvation Committee didn't take the bait.
Albedo met Nazuka and me last night...
I bring good news. Dusk Arbiter declaring the Salvation Committee heretics has triggered a wave of defections. We have secured a massive intelligence haul from the repentant members.
Angie has issued new orders. Committee members are mobilizing toward somewhere in the west of the Nova Empire.
The west? That makes no sense. Philae is in the south. If they wanted to hit us, they would be heading south.
We don't know the exact orders. However, their trajectory strongly indicates they have abandoned Philae as a target. The road to Emor should also be clear of their forces.
You should take this window to escort Boss to Emor. Clear ==SEX3== name at the conference this month, and you can all go back to your normal lives.
Thank you for the tip, but when and how Boss goes to Emor isn't something I can decide on my own. After daybreak, I'll discuss it with my companions.
Wait. The Salvation Committee is ignoring Philae? Why? Nazuka, you just said my acting was flawless!
It is not your fault, Nazuna. They did not ignore Philae because of your disguise.
Think about it. Even if they figured out you were a fake, how could they know the real Boss wasn't hiding here too?
The fact that they're mobilizing somewhere else means they've already tracked Boss down through other channels.
Master went to a desert in the west... Oh no, Master is in trouble! Just the four of them against an entire army!
That brings us to the real agenda. We use the "escort mission to Emor" as a cover, slip out, and head straight for the desert to back them up.
If the Salvation Committee isn't coming here, we absolutely should go. Even just to take off some of the pressure. But ... do we really need to keep them in the dark about it?
We have to, Kaede. You know how Boss is. If we just said, "Philae is safe, so we are coming to the desert," how do you think ==SEX=='d react?
==SEX1=='d shoot it down immediately. When we set up the decoy plan, ==SEX== didn't say much, but that look on ==SEX3== face... ==SEX1== was eaten up with guilt for dragging us into this.
Exactly. If ==SEX== knows we're safe here, ==SEX=='ll fight tooth and nail to keep us out of the crossfire. ==SEX1=='d never put us in danger.
Master ... is just trying to protect us.
My ==SEX11== coddles me far too much. I am a blade. My only purpose is to strike down my ==SEX11=='s enemies.
It's more than just wanting to protect us. ==SEX1== is the kind of leader who insists on taking every hit. ==SEX1=='ll throw ==SEX8== on the front line every time if it spares someone else.
And that is exactly why we became comrades who trust each other with our lives.
Keeping us out of danger is ==SEX3== choice. Showing up anyway is mine.
I'm a Trekker. I carve my own path. I refuse to sit around like some wilting greenhouse flower waiting to be watered.
We all know how strong the Salvation Committee is. This journey will be brutal. Nazuka and I called this meeting to gauge your resolve and lock in our roster.
You dragged us all the way out here just for that?
Like anyone in this room was ever going to say no.
My patience ran dry days ago. I am ready to march right now and take my place as my ==SEX11=='s vanguard.
I... I know I still have a lot to learn, but I am going to help Master no matter what!
Logistics are on me. Are we rolling out today? I need to start packing.
Well, keeping Nazuna looking like Boss on the road means constant touch-ups. Count me in.
Then the roster is set. We head out today, hitching a ride with the Imperial Guard convoy bound for Mirage.
Hehe, a covert rescue op! Think of the photo ops! But, uh... Not to ruin the mood, but aren't you forgetting a tiny detail?
According to your deal with Albedo, even on the road to Emor, Boss has to broadcast to Scarlet Sights Media every single day. Just to assure all Novians ==SEX=='s not out to end the world.
You cannot just detour into a desert with that restriction. And splitting the party? People are watching you. Missing faces will spark rumors instantly.
I have a solution for that. But I will need a favor, Mistique.
A favor? I would love to, but I am still a witch.
If someone catches me helping you, they will assume Boss Accord and Scarlet Sights Media are colluding. Your daily broadcasts would look staged.
It won't go that far. I just need you to deliver a letter.
I am a witch, not a courier...==W== Fine, whatever. Where to?
Emor's Ash District. Under the Waterway. The Ashwind Clan.
10:00, Nebula Month 12th, The Wilds, Unnamed Forest
Lady Firenze. Two more days north and you will spot Emor's Monolith. My unit is hauling grain to Mirage, so we will be breaking west from here.
We appreciate the escort. Having your squad clear the monsters off the road saved us a lot of grief.
Don't mention it. You're paying the tab, and we're guarding the Boss of Boss Accord. It's the least we could do.
That fiercely dedicated young knight...==W== Tilia, correct?==W== She was spectacular during the Gale Owl battle yesterday.
Ahaha, she's actually still a squire! But with how she swings a sword, the brass will knight her soon enough.==W== Tilia! Get over here and thank Lady Firenze!
Thank you, Lady Firenze!==W== I was only doing my duty!
I'll write a letter of recommendation to the Imperial Guard. It should help with your promotion to a full knight. If there's anything else you need, please let me know.==W==
Um... There was actually something I wanted to ask you, if that's alright...==W==
I heard Emor is holding a conference to judge Boss's identity.==W== Is ==SEX== going to be okay?
==SEX1=='ll be fine. I've known ==SEX4== for a long time.==W== ==SEX1== has absolutely no interest in "ending the world."
Grace Imperium and the company reps aren't fools. They won't buy the Salvation Committee's slander. They'll clear ==SEX3== name.
T-That's a relief! If you need someone to testify, I'll do it! I can swear on record that ==SEX=='s a good person!

Well, we've crossed paths a few times! We haven't really talked,==W== but you can just tell by looking at ==SEX4==! ==SEX1== fights for justice, just as I do! I'll stake my honor as a squire on it...==W==
Staking honor as a squire? And testifying?==W== This isn't going to drag the Imperial Guard into it, is it?!
Let's go! Stop bothering Lady Firenze!==W== Ahaha, I'm so sorry.==W== That's just how the kid is. Once she starts talking about justice, she never stops.
Heh heh, it's quite alright. I'll pass your support on to Boss, Tilia. We might just hold you to that testimony.
Well then, Lady Firenze, this is where we part ways. Safe travels.
I've heard the Salvation Committee is mobilizing in a similar direction to your route. Please be careful.
Thank you for the warning, but I doubt they'd waste their time on a simple grain convoy...
Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!
Box them in!==W== Kill the Tyrant!
Master, let's go!==W== I'll protect you!
Captain, contact Dusk Arbiter, hurry! Report to them that we were attacked by the Salvation Committee! I'm going after Boss.
Should we go help, too? A lot of people from the Committee have arrived, and they've all rushed into the forest!
Help what?! We're hauling grain to Mirage, not playing bodyguard for the Boss!
I don't want to hear it. We follow Lady Firenze's orders. Tilia, get to Emor right now. Report this to the Dusk Arbiter and United Harvest Philae!

(Was that really the Salvation Committee...?==W== I don't know about the others... But there's no way that swordswoman would be pushed back by such weak attacks. It almost feels like it was staged...)
(Nope, stop overthinking this. Let the big shots play their games. Us grunts are better off staying blind and deaf to this kind of stuff!)
14:00, Nebula Month 18th, Mirage, Deep in the Mine
So the Ashwind Clan played the Committee, the Guards played the witnesses, and you faked my kidnapping in the Wilds just to sneak into Mirage.==W== Did I get that right?
Precisely.==W== Lady Firenze also asked me to pass along a message, my ==SEX11==.
She noted that any clash with the Salvation Committee near Mirage would inevitably draw attention. We needed a convincing reason for you to suddenly appear here instead of Philae.
Without it, people would realize the Boss they saw back in Philae was a decoy. That would severely damage public trust in you.
Yeah, that's true. I didn't expect Angie to corner me in Mirage. Firenze really thinks of everything. So what happened after you hit the desert?
I was going to use Heartlink to contact you right away,==W== but Mistique spotted the Committee's forces way too close to us.
Word is the Dusk Arbiter has ways to tap into local Heartlinks. We figured the Committee might too, so we stayed off the network and just tailed them.
We watched them set up camp on the dunes outside Mirage and send a squad down here.
So we followed them inside and bumped right into their scouting spell. I used my own magic to block theirs while using the wind to search for you. Luckily, I got here just in time.
So that green mist was you. Where are the others?
Firenze and Nyx split off as soon as we spotted the Committee.==W== They headed to Emor to hire the Imperial Guard, and contact Dusk Arbiter to be our backup.
Kaede, Itoha, Minova, and Mistique stayed behind in the dunes,==W== on standby to get us out.==W== That's the whole rundown.
Except it's too dangerous for us, right?==W== I knew you were gonna say that!
Look, of course we know the risks.==W== But we...==W== We had to come! We all agreed on that!
Ah... Uh... I actually wasn't going to say that.
You weren't?! Then why the dramatic pause?!
Because it was cute seeing you like that. You don't usually get this worked up, Nazuka.
I did. And you're not entirely wrong. A few weeks ago, I definitely would have tried to bench you for your own safety. But...
I've been an idiot. I was so focused on keeping all of you safe, I forgot you wanted to keep me safe too.
Keep your head up! Don't underestimate us. Everyone in Philae has been to hell and back with you.
Noya knocked some sense into me earlier. Trying to push you guys away was an insult to those who care about me.
So, I'm happy you are here!
Nazuka, Chitose, Nazuna, Fuyuka, I need your help. Let's fight our way out of here together!
No problem. But hey, Boss, don't leave us hanging. What were you actually gonna say earlier?
Oh, just that your little "kidnapping" act isn't going to fool anyone with half a brain.==W== Everyone knows how strong you are. You'd never fold that easily.
Haha! That's 'cause Nazuka is a terrible actress!==W== "Oh! No!==W== It's the Salvation Committee!"
As if the Trekker who soloed the Blade of Jade would actually squeal over a few random grunts!
I couldn't actually fight back!==W== I did my best!
Forgive me, my ==SEX11==. My performance was equally unconvincing.
Don't sweat it. The smart ones won't interfere anyway. They'll just hang back and wait to see who survives.
Boss, we're at the exit. Bad news though, the streets are crawling with Committee grunts.
Focus on reaching Daisy Orphanage. Ignore everything else.
We lock that down, and the Tyrant has no choice but to face us.
Oh god, they're going for the orphanage! Boss, keep the kids safe! I'll hold them off!
Huh? Kids, what are you doing?
Mom, here.==W== Take Loxy's keys and get the others out of here.
Absolutely not! I am not letting you risk your lives!
Mom, please. The younger ones need you. You're the only one who can get them evacuated fast enough.
Benito, rally the rest of the White Cats and guard the kids. Chaton and I are staying here. You three can't hold this line alone.
Nazuna, Fuyuka, get Boss out of here. I'm staying. My wind walls can buy us time. Are you good with this, Boss?
No time to second-guess this. We know too little right now. Angie really caught us off guard this time.
The rest of us can handle the orphanage. Chitose, stay with them. It's time to draw your blade.
We just need twenty minutes! After that, fall back to the Eureka Bar!
Move! Daisy Orphanage is right at the end of the block!
Hold. As long as I draw breath, you will not take a single step further!
One of the Tyrant's lackeys. Lady Angie only asked for the Tyrant's head, but if you're that eager to die, we'll gladly oblige!
I offer you slumber granted by the wild spirits.
Gah! The wind's too strong! Cast a counter magic!
Tch. She actually forced the cast out before she fell.
Heads up, Chitose! These guys aren't your average Trekkers. They're actually trained for this!
Don't let them stop you. Get to the orphanage!==W== Pin them down and have the rest flank around!
They're splitting up. Chaton, on me! We're intercepting the flankers!
Heheheh! Prepare to get a taste of the great Chaton's dark power!!
There are so many of them... Can we actually hold this line?
Iris, Amber, we're diving straight into the mob! If we cause enough chaos, they won't have time to go after Mom and ==PLAYER_NAME==!
I'll take on the tough ones.
